messages:
Anya: RFC brainstorm: add a 'guided_cost_cap' rollout mode that limits routing shifts when projected cost delta > X%. We need API shape, console UX, preflight replay, and safety gates.

Leo: High level yes. Two questions: 1) How strict is the cap (hard-stop vs notify)? 2) How do we calculate projected cost (tokens * pool_price)?

Mina: UX: three options in the console: Pause, Revert, Notify. Default to Pause. Show estimated cost delta per minute and a confidence band. Also display "quota headroom" and a small badge if approval needed.

Kevin: Runtime: implement as a per-rollout budget counter. During rollout we estimate cost_delta per request = (new_pool_cost - baseline_cost) * est_tokens. Accumulate, compare to cap. On hit -> perform configured action. Need idempotency_key for retries.

Leo: API suggestion: POST /v1/rollouts { name, flag, mode: guided_cost_cap, cost_cap_pct, action_on_hit: pause|revert|notify, idempotency_key }. Make routing_hint optional for backwards compat.

Anya: Telemetry: emit rollout.preview, rollout.step, rollout.budget_hit. Include fields: rollout_id, cohort, applied_pct, p95_before, p95_after, cost_delta_pct, sample_size.

Mina: Console dry-run: replay last_1h sample and show p95 & cost delta. Add option to run replay offline (no cache writes) and show replay id.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: queued replay job replay-9001 for sample=last_1h, rollout=guided_cost_cap/1769980000. Will post results here.

Kevin: Implementation detail: projection accuracy can be poor if tokens vary. Include token percentiles (p10/p50/p90) in preview so owners see confidence. Also cap should consider burst quota + dedicated capacity allowances.

Leo: Alerts: create temp rule for rollout that auto-pauses if error_rate +0.5% absolute or p95 regresses >15% for 5m. Also pause if rollout.budget_hit persists >30s.

Anya: Ops: please schedule a canary to internal only first. @deploy-bot ?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary eng-platform-canary, 2% internal traffic starting at 1769980020 for 20m. Posting perf snapshot when done.

Mina: QA note: verify dry-run vs replayed results within +/-20% cost, make sure replay doesn't touch caches, and verify audit record created for every guided rollout.

Anya: I'll write the RFC with API examples and console mocks. Will include sample body: ```json
{
  "name": "prefer-fast-pools",
  "flag": "route_prefer_low_latency",
  "mode": "guided_cost_cap",
  "cost_cap_pct": 8,
  "action_on_hit": "pause",
  "idempotency_key": "uuid-5678"
}
```

Leo: LGTM. Add note about stale cost telemetry: if cost data is >2m old, reduce step size by 50% until fresh metrics resume.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: replay-9001 complete. Results: projected_p95_delta=+3.2%, projected_cost_delta=+6.7% (median), token_p50=45. Posted replay id replay-9001 to /rollout/previews.

Anya: Great — thanks. I'll post RFC link when ready and open a small API PR.
